purpose: FP16 GEMM development pilot. This is not a P8 model fit and contains no P9 concrete hold-out cases.
rules: Fresh process per schedule/trial; compile, single synchronized run, correctness, warmup, then timing.
No MUSAGraph and no torch Profiler.
Only all-three-trial correct and stable schedules are development-measured; failed schedules remain in the manifest.
This config cannot be used as P9 hold-out input.

reserved_p9_space.rule: After P8 freeze, sample FP16 GEMM shapes from powers-of-two and non-divisible M/N/K intervals excluding every P7.3 development shape and schedule tuple. Do not generate or compile concrete cases before P8 SHA freeze.
